remarks: Welcome to 1459 Wyoming Ave – a fantastic opportunity in the desirable Deveaux neighborhood! This charming 4-bedroom, 1-bath Cape Cod sits on a quiet, tree-lined street just minutes from Niagara University, making it an ideal option for both owner-occupants and savvy investors. Inside, you’ll find a flexible layout with four bedrooms, offering plenty of space for families, roommates, or a home office setup. An additional room provides convenient laundry space along with extra storage—always a plus for functionality and organization. Step outside to enjoy a concrete driveway for easy parking and a generously sized backyard complete with a patio—perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or future outdoor upgrades. For investors, this property presents strong rental potential with upside, especially given its proximity to the university and surrounding amenities. For first-time buyers, it’s an affordable way to build equity in a well-established neighborhood. Whether you’re looking to expand your portfolio or settle into your first home, this property offers value, location, and opportunity all in one.
